propositions: No current bug carries detected_by metadata or tag, preventing calculation of true escaped-defect rate or detection-stage efficiency; caused_by advisory links are noisy and demonstrably subject to blame-attribution false positives.

Plan review first-pass rate is 49.0% with p90 attempts of 8, consuming 116,560 LLM calls across 4,530 result records; adoption of review-before-claim rose from 29.2% (Q2) to 79.5% (Q3) but churn remains high.

Completion first-pass is 72.3% (722/998); tickets with Testing sections or declared file impact show correlations with better outcomes (79.7% and 74.2% respectively), but lack of classification for non-PASS reasons prevents root-cause attribution.

Code-review first-pass is 97.4% (1,178/1,209); caused_by-source tickets show 96.6% first-pass code review but only 30.3% initial plan PASS, and larger median diffs (912 vs 256 LOC) increase blame-attribution likelihood.

Source diff median shrank from 111.5 to 95 LOC (Q2→Q3) with fewer high-churn commits; median test co-change increased from 84.5 to 160.5 LOC; ticket trailers, DCO, and Change-Id reached ~100% adoption by late August.

35 source modules occupy 720+ LOC (15 at 780+), duplication is 4.09% with 0.231 refactor-to-addition ratio; same-file retouch within 24h is 47.7% of consecutive pairs, signaling hotspot/coordination pressure rather than rework proof.
